notes.graphite: Marketplace tile background and galleryBanner colour.
notes.coral: The only mark colour (orange-coral, not red). Used on the graphite tile only.
notes.sidebar-dark: Test background for the monochrome glyphs on a dark sidebar.
notes.sidebar-light: Test background for the monochrome glyphs on a light sidebar.
notes.marketplace-dark: Test background for the Marketplace icon on a dark surface.
notes.glyph-*: Stand-ins for the theme foreground colour that VS Code applies to the currentColor glyphs. The real colour comes from the user's theme.

pairs.use: activity-bar / terminal-tab glyph, dark theme, active
activity-bar / terminal-tab glyph, light theme, active
tile edge against a light Marketplace surface
tile edge against a dark Marketplace surface (informational: the tile blends in; the mark stays readable)
DO NOT USE: bare coral mark on white fails 3:1, so always keep the graphite tile
